cpi_headline_yoy.note: Latest official 12-month rate (Sep). BLS published no Oct y/y because Oct 2025 data were not collected during the shutdown. Cleveland Fed estimates Oct ~3.8% y/y (USA Today); not official.

cpi_headline_mom.note: Released 10 Nov. Seasonally adjusted, vs 0.3% est (Dow Jones/Reuters); Sep 0.6%. Third straight gain of 0.4%+ (Reuters). Energy +0.7%, gasoline +1%, food +0.5%, shelter +0.3% (>30% of rise).

core_cpi_yoy.note: Latest official 12-month core rate (Sep). No official Oct y/y (shutdown gap).

core_cpi_mom.note: vs 0.2% est; third straight 0.3%. Inflation Insights sees core PCE ~0.34% for Oct (Reuters).

fed_funds_target_range.note: Held 28 Oct, vote 10-2. Unchanged as of 10 Nov.

next_fomc.note: Decision Wed 9 Dec 2:00 PM ET (Thu 10 Dec 3:00 AM SGT). After CPI, a hike of at least 25bp is fully priced (CME FedWatch via Reuters, from 84% Mon); 50bp odds ~10-15% intraday, ~11.8% at close. Oct minutes 18 Nov.

us_10y_yield.note: +0.119 pts (Portfolio Terminal/FRED); Sharecast 4.986%. Briefly above 5.00% intraday (@KobeissiLetter).

unemployment_rate.note: Down from 4.2%; forecast 4.2%. U-6 rose 0.3pt to 7.9%; participation 61.9%.

nonfarm_payrolls.note: Released 6 Nov vs Dow Jones est +59k (Reuters poll 65k). Aug revised to 186k, Sep to 60k (+84k combined). AHE +0.4% m/m, +3.1% y/y.
